purpose: Run the strategy as a realistic paper-live journal as if self-funded: faithfully record every valid OPEN/EXIT using observed executable-side quotes, measure actual leveraged-product performance against the same-period 1x benchmark, and preserve the full decision/audit trail without sending broker orders.

eligible_signals.default_vehicle_preference: SPY uses SSO for live-test; QQQ uses QLD for live-test; SOXX formal product path uses the currently validated actual-product route recorded by policy/state. SMH has no trade vehicle authority.

historical_quote_reconstruction.purpose: Recover the lifecycle price that would have been available at the original eligible RTH time when the scheduled run occurred outside RTH or a fresh observation was missed.
historical_quote_reconstruction.selection_rule: Use the first timestamped RTH quote at or after the eligible lifecycle time that passes the same spread, halt and quote-integrity gates. Do not choose a later or more favourable quote.
historical_quote_reconstruction.label: HISTORICAL_QUOTE_RECONSTRUCTION

exit_policy.if_no_qualifying_fresh_rth_exit_quote: Attempt audited historical Level-1 reconstruction of the first qualifying RTH bid. If an authoritative reconstruction is available, record it with source/timestamp/fidelity; otherwise keep exit price N/A. Never use a later close or estimated price.
exit_policy.reentry_after_exit: New live-test instance only after a new completed-RTH entry signal plus required validation and fresh qualifying IBKR RTH ask.

performance_accounting.benchmark_timestamp_rule: Use the same lifecycle observation timestamp for leveraged product and 1x underlying whenever available; otherwise use the closest reliable same-session observed underlying quote and label the basis. Never silently mix timestamps.
performance_accounting.missing_price_rule: If a fresh lifecycle quote was missed, first attempt audited timestamped historical Level-1 reconstruction under the reconstruction policy. If no authoritative qualifying archive exists, realized P&L and excess return remain N/A. Never substitute a later close, premarket, after-hours or estimated price.

github_audit_rules.append_or_update_rule: State/ledger may be updated from fresh observed data OR an audited timestamped historical Level-1 reconstruction that follows the original lifecycle rule. Every reconstruction must preserve source, timestamp, spread, fidelity, and reconstruction time.

lifecycle_state_semantics.OPEN: Activated live-test with a recorded qualifying fresh IBKR RTH entry observation.
lifecycle_state_semantics.EXIT: Exit/invalidation signal has triggered; strategy is no longer open. If fresh exit quote was missed, reconstruct first qualifying RTH bid from authoritative historical Level-1 archive when available; otherwise keep N/A.
lifecycle_state_semantics.reentry: A later re-entry is a new live-test instance and requires a new completed-RTH entry signal, required same-run validation, and a fresh qualifying IBKR RTH ask. There is no pending lifecycle state.
lifecycle_state_semantics.historical_reconstruction: A reconstruction is not a broker execution. It is an audited replay of the first eligible historical quote under the same rules.
